description: Search cinematic website templates, preview designs, and retrieve free build prompts and UI or 3D component code.
longDescription: Find website designs by style, theme and stack. Inspect poster and video previews, retrieve free template build prompts, and get editable HTML, CSS and JavaScript for UI and 3D components. This connector retrieves library assets; the host assistant can use them to build within the user’s requested project. It does not generate or publish websites through VividSites Create. Premium prompts are not included in this unauthenticated connection.
examples: Find three cinematic landing-page templates and show their previews.
Get the complete free build prompt for cinematic.
Find a magnetic button and retrieve its HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
